Maria (CS): Heads-up: AstraNova renewal landed today. Procurement says they need an evidence bundle (SOC2 + latest pen-test) and confirmation that SSO + KMS onboarding are complete before Legal will sign. We have the upsell discount tied to completion, cc @Liam
Liam (Account Exec): Thanks Maria — what's specifically missing from their side? I pinged procurement earlier; they said security owns the artifacts.
Tom (Onboarding): We have SSO in staging, KMS keys provisioned but rotation not done. ETA to finish KMS work is ~3 business days once AstraNova accepts the IAM role invite. Need their infra contact to accept.
Maria (CS): Procurement also wants the invoice mapped to "BlueEdge Inc." and PO PO-001234. Legal won't e-sign until entity matches the contract. @Sophie can Legal pre-author an amendment template referencing the PO?
Sophie (Legal): I can draft an amendment that references PO-001234 and allows provisional signature pending entity docs, but Legal needs confirmation that the pen-test PDF was sent to procurement. Please attach the official PDF (signed by vendor).
Liam (Account Exec): I forwarded the summary, but procurement asked for the official vendor-signed PDF. Pinged AstraNova security for the file — @AstraNova-Security any ETA?
DocuSignBot: Envelope EN-8921 created by Sophie (Legal) for AstraNova — awaiting signature from "CFO - BlueEdge Inc."
Tom (Onboarding): Possible workaround: we can flip a KMS "minimal" flag to consider KMS onboarded for initial rollout (no immediate rotation) to unblock the renewal for 72h while we finish rotation. Would procurement accept that as evidence of onboarding?
Maria (CS): Procurement said provisional onboarding + operational checklist is acceptable if we supply direct infra contact and timeline. I'll send the checklist link and request their infra contact now. Reminder: upsell discount window is 7 days.
Liam (Account Exec): I'll escalate to the CFO and ask for the signed PO + pen-test PDF. Will report back in 2h.
Maria (CS): :thumbsup: Operational checklist here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ONB-234/checklist — includes artifacts they asked for. @Tom can you add concrete dates in the tracker?
Tom (Onboarding): Added: SSO staging->prod 48h after role acceptance; KMS minimal done in 72h, full rotation + audit in 5 business days. Updated the onboarding tracker and flagged the AstraNova row.
Sophie (Legal): Amendment draft attached to the envelope; included provisional-mapping clause. Will hold execution until entity docs (W-9 / registration) are received.
Liam (Account Exec): Great — once we have the CFO signature and the pen-test PDF, we'll confirm the discount. If not signed within the 7-day window, discount terms revert. I'll follow up ASAP.
Maria (CS): Thanks all — I'll chase procurement for the infra contact and upload any received artifacts to the checklist.
